notes:
- Map generation rebuilt from the ground up. Rooms now have their own ceiling heights (up to 12 m), and
  big rooms get upper levels you (and the zombies) reach by stairs:
  - Prison Cell Blocks with two tiers of barred cells, catwalks, stairs and an open atrium; a new
    Gymnasium with huge bleachers; balconies in the Chapel and Warden's Office; a climbable
    watchtower with a searchlight in the Exercise Yard; pillars in the big halls.
  - Outskirts two-storey houses with an upstairs loft, balconies in the Auto Shop and Sheriff's Office,
    a gazebo in the park.
  - Laboratory catwalk balconies in the Bio Labs and Archive, and a 12 m Incubation Chamber with
    catwalks on both sides joined by a bridge.
- Each map looks different: its own pixel textures (concrete block, brick, siding, wallpaper, planks,
  tiles, lab panels, grates, asphalt, grass), wall trim, lights, fog and sky.
  - Prison: cage lamps on chains, steel beams, painted bands, pipes, bars between some rooms, a concrete
    perimeter wall with razor wire, guard towers and floodlights.
  - Outskirts: streets with sidewalks and lane markings, crosswalks, houses and shops with stepped roofs,
    shuttered windows (some lit), wooden fences, chain-link between yards, barricades instead of gates.
  - Laboratory: underground in a rock cavern (no sky), white panels with glowing strips, glass walls
    between some rooms, blast doors.
- Bunker hatch opens onto a real hole with a ladder down a concrete shaft; in the bunker the ladder
  goes up the shaft to the surface.
- 4 new guns: Vanguard AR (wall), Twin Barrels double-barrel (wall), Tri-Burst Carbine (3-round burst,
  box) and the Thumper grenade launcher (explosive, box).
- 3 melee weapons on the walls: Slugger Bat (1000), Fire Axe (1500) and Katana (2500). They replace the
  knife on [V], hit several zombies per swing, get stronger in later rounds and each has its own swing.
- Bullets go through zombies on the strong guns: Longshot (5 zombies), Hand Cannon (4), Boomstick and
  Twin Barrels (3), LMG, AR and Tri-Burst (2). Each zombie after the first takes 85% damage.
- Boomstick damage raised (45 to 80 per pellet).
- Weapon upgrade machine (5000 points), always at least 4 rooms away from the start room. Upgraded
  guns do double damage, have bigger magazines, more ammo, go through one more zombie, get a new name and
  an animated purple finish.
- Longshot: your right hand comes up and works the bolt after each shot and when reloading.
- Hand Cannon reload redone: swing out the cylinder, tip it up and punch the ejector (empty brass
  falls out), speedloader in, twist, flick it shut and spin.
- Camos redone: Jungle and Desert Digital, Carbon Fiber, Glacier and Bloodshot (glowing veins),
  Inferno Tiger (glowing stripes), engraved Royal Gold, faceted sparkling Diamond, animated Plasma, and a
  new animated Dark Matter camo at level 55.
- Perks: buying one plays a drinking animation with sounds (pop, gulps, burp), and you can't shoot,
  aim or reload until you're done. Perks show as small icons on the HUD. Iron Gut no longer makes the
  health bar 2.5 times longer.
- New perk machines and Mystery Box built in voxels: arcade cabinets with a lit marquee, chasing bulbs,
  pixel perk icon, bottles behind glass; an iron-banded chest with glowing question marks and a light beam.
- Power-ups are now floating pixel icons (ammo crate, 2X, skull, bomb) with no text. Active power-ups
  show their icon on the HUD with the name and time left above it.
- Barricades: tapping E no longer repairs faster than holding it (one board every 0.6 s, also limited
  on the host); no points for boards while a zombie is tearing at that window, and repair points are
  capped at 400 per round.
- Zombies: crawlers now lie on the floor (they were floating). Stuck zombies sidestep and hop, then get
  moved along their path, then sent back out a window; zombies that fall out of the map, never reach their
  window or stop getting closer for 25 seconds are also moved. Zombies only attack you on the same level.
